title: SOC2 action pad — Olivia Chen
content:
Quick action pad for the next 48 hours — messy brain dump + micro-checklist. Status: juggling evidence ingestion, one vendor deep-dive, and a policy update that keeps getting bumped.

Top slices (priority order):
1) Evidence ingestion backlog (SLO: clear 12 items by Fri) — files labeled mismatch: 'access-logs-2025-12-*.zip' need normalizing. Action: run evidence-fix script, then tag in Confluence. -> follow up with Marcus to confirm retention policy mapping.
2) Vendor: TelemetryCorp contract review (low-risk?) — open questions: does their subprocessor list include third-party analytics? Need written attestation for data residency (APAC). NOTES from call 3/23: Telemetry says data-at-rest in GCP us-central by default; can enable europe-node for additional cost. TODO: draft email template asking for SOC2 report + AICPA letter of attestation.
3) Policy TODO: update 'Acceptable Use — Dev Keys' to include hardware key rotation cadence and KMS reference. Draft snippet below (inline): "Rotation cadence for dev keys: 90d; for service accounts with long-lived keys require approval and rotation plan." Put in GitHub PR under infra/docs.

Quick checklist (tick when done):
- [ ] Normalize naming for evidence files (SEC-412)
- [ ] Request TelemetryCorp SOC2 + subprocessor list (email template ready)
- [ ] Add KMS rotation language to AUP doc and open PR
- [ ] Reconcile access logs for playground cluster (timestamps off by +1hr)
- [ ] Confirm archival policy in Confluence (point to retention matrix)

Notes & gotchas:
- Evidence upload times sometimes fail on large zips (timeouts). Workaround: split into 100MB parts and re-upload; long-term: ask infra to bump multipart timeout.
- Audit numbering: use SEC-YYYY-### prefix to avoid collisions with finance tags.
- When asking vendors for SOC2 reports, prefer PDF + signed cover letter. If only cloud-hosted, request ephemeral link and copy to evidence store.

Short-term plan for tomorrow morning (9–11am):
- 9:00 standup with Marcus (10m) — confirm he can run the evidence-fix script and share results to #sec-evidence
- 9:30 vendor email drafts, aim to send to TelemetryCorp and Auditly (if needed)
- 10:15 start AUP doc edit, open PR, tag Ivy for review

Open questions to resolve:
- Does Dedicated customers' evidence need separate retention rules? (ask legal)
- Can we make Confluence auto-scan for missing metadata fields on uploaded evidence? (engineering spike?)

Snippets for copy-paste: 
Email to vendor:
"Hi — following up from our call on 3/23. Could you please share your most recent SOC2 Type II report and a current subprocessor list? Additionally, can you confirm data residency options for EU customers and whether an AICPA letter of attestation is available? Thanks, Olivia (Redwood Inference)"

Folder pointers: evidence store -> confluence index -> tag with SEC-2026 prefix.

Random ticks: feeling low bandwidth — keep mornings for focused triage. If I hit >3 blockers in a row, escalate to Marcus for a quick pairing session.

End of pad. Will prune into formal ticket(s) after midday triage.
